0x18.label: Sound Trigger
0x18.description: Invisible collision that karts drive through, not on. As a kart crosses it, the game changes the track's sound to the variant's: which music tracks play, echo, ambience. What each variant does depends on the course whose music plays.
0x18.notes: In the game's tracks Sound Triggers are upright one-sided gates across the road, in pairs about 200 units apart: first a gate facing ahead with the variant karts get back when driving back, then a gate facing the karts with the new variant. Painted onto the road's own triangles, the road stops being road there.

1.label: Indoors music
1.description: Where the bats come from the sides.

0x1A.label: Effect Trigger
0x1A.description: Invisible collision that karts pass through: the game starts or stops one of the track's effects as they do. The variant chooses the effect.
0x1A.notes: The game's tracks use upright gates across the road and flat planes (over water, sand or a jump), not the road itself. What each variant does on each track is not documented here yet.

0x11.label: Cannon Activator
0x11.description: Touching it shoots the kart out of a cannon. The variant is the cannon target it flies to: its number in the Cannons section.

0x10.label: Fall Boundary
0x10.description: Touching it counts as falling: Lakitu picks the kart up and puts it back on the track at a respawn point (Respawns section).

0x0A.label: Solid Fall (sand/lava)
0x0A.description: Karts can drive on it but sink: like a Fall Boundary, they are put back at a respawn point.

0x07.label: Boost Ramp
0x07.description: Boosts the kart and launches it: the player can trick in the air.
0x07.notes: Other surfaces can also allow a trick when driven off: the Trickable flag of the collision, shown with its settings.

0x06.label: Boost Panel
0x06.description: Gives a speed boost to karts driving over it, as a mushroom does.

0x12.label: Force Recalculation
0x12.description: CPU karts touching it work out their route again.
